name: Fleetwood Mac

whyMatters.en: British-American band formed in 1967. The 1975–87 Buckingham–Nicks lineup made stacked harmony and studio polish the commercial core; Rumours (1977) is the main sales and radio reference.
whyMatters.zh: 英美乐队，1967 年成立。1975–87 年 Buckingham–Nicks 阵容以叠和声与录音室抛光构成商业核心；Rumours（1977）是主要销量与电台参照。

note.en: From Rumours; fingerstyle guitar drive and stacked choruses.
note.zh: 出自 Rumours；指弹吉他驱动与叠副歌。

note.en: Nicks vocal over a sparse groove; US No.1 single.
note.zh: Nicks 人声盖在稀疏律动上；美国冠军单曲。

note.en: Peter Green blues-rock era, before the mid-1970s pop focus.
note.zh: Peter Green 蓝调摇滚期，早于 1970 年代中期的流行重心。

interviewQuotes.text: We made Rumours while breaking up with each other.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Lindsey Buckingham

interviewQuotes.text: The arrangements had to be tighter than the relationships.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stevie Nicks

lyricQuotes: If I could / Baby I'd give you my world
Thunder only happens when it's raining

shortBio.en: Buckingham–Nicks Rumours peak; Peter Green blues origin; Go Your Own Way is a key single.
shortBio.zh: Buckingham–Nicks 的 Rumours 高峰；Peter Green 蓝调起源；Go Your Own Way 是关键单曲。

body.en:
Fleetwood Mac formed in 1967 as a Peter Green blues band with John McVie and Mick Fleetwood. Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks joined in 1975. Fleetwood Mac (1975) and Rumours (1977) set California soft-rock harmony over that UK rhythm section.

Two eras matter for the catalog: Green-era blues rock, then the Buckingham–Nicks five. Commercial peak sits on Rumours and the mid-1970s–80s studio albums.
body.zh:
Fleetwood Mac 于 1967 年作为 Peter Green 蓝调乐队成立，成员含 John McVie 与 Mick Fleetwood。Lindsey Buckingham 与 Stevie Nicks 于 1975 年加入。同名专辑（1975）与 Rumours（1977）在英国节奏组之上确立加州软摇滚和声。

目录上有两个主要时期：Green 时期蓝调摇滚，以及 Buckingham–Nicks 五人组。商业高峰落在 Rumours 与 1970 年代中期至 80 年代的录音室专辑。

title.zh: 录音室和声与电台长度歌曲

body.en:
Rumours centers stacked vocals, Buckingham’s fingerstyle attack, and radio-length songs. Band drama was biographical; the recorded sound is careful multi-track craft.

Soft-rock songwriting sits over firm arrangement and rhythm.
body.zh:
Rumours 以叠人声、Buckingham 的指弹攻击与电台长度歌曲为中心。乐队戏剧是传记事实；录音声音是细致的多轨工艺。

软摇滚写法压在明确的编排与节奏之上。

title.zh: Green 蓝调与 Buckingham–Nicks 高峰

body.en:
1967–70: Green, McVie, and Fleetwood blues-rock. 1975–87: Buckingham, Nicks, Christine McVie, John McVie, and Mick Fleetwood form the best-known commercial lineup.

Rumours five is the peak commercial chapter. The blues chapter is the origin of the name and early catalog.
body.zh:
1967–70：Green、McVie 与 Fleetwood 的蓝调摇滚。1975–87：Buckingham、Nicks、Christine McVie、John McVie 与 Mick Fleetwood 构成最知名的商业阵容。

Rumours 五人组是商业高峰章节。蓝调章节是团名与早期目录的起源。

body.en:
Nicks, Christine McVie, and Buckingham share lead vocals. Buckingham produces and fingerpicks. John McVie and Mick Fleetwood keep a blues pocket under the pop sheen.

Mic placement and vocal stacking are part of the studio identity.
body.zh:
Nicks、Christine McVie 与 Buckingham 分主唱。Buckingham 负责制作与指弹。John McVie 与 Mick Fleetwood 在流行光泽下保持蓝调律动。

话筒位置与人声叠层是录音室身份的一部分。

body.en:
Acoustic-electric drive, Nicks harmony answers, and Fleetwood tom hits. Breakup lyric on a radio single.

A main face track of the Buckingham–Nicks era.
body.zh:
木电驱动、Nicks 和声应答与 Fleetwood 通通鼓。分手歌词落在电台单曲上。

Buckingham–Nicks 时期的主要门面曲之一。

body.en:
Minimal groove, Nicks lead, Christine McVie keys pad. Shows Rumours range beyond uptempo rockers.

US chart peak single for this lineup.
body.zh:
极简律动、Nicks 主唱、Christine McVie 键盘垫。展示 Rumours 不止快节奏摇滚曲。

该阵容的美国榜峰值单曲。

title.zh: 跨年代引用的和声流行

body.en:
Adult-contemporary and later indie acts often cite Rumours vocal stacking. Green-era tracks remain blues-club references.

The chronicle keeps both eras; commercial peak stays on the five.
body.zh:
成人当代与后来的 indie 乐队常引用 Rumours 的人声叠层。Green 时期曲目仍是蓝调俱乐部参照。

编年史保留两个时期；商业高峰仍在五人组。

note.zh: Rumours 与 Tusk 商业高峰。

note.en: Rumours single that fixed the Buckingham–Nicks radio identity.
note.zh: 确立 Buckingham–Nicks 电台身份的 Rumours 单曲。

note.en: Blues origin and Rumours harmony under one band name.
note.zh: 同一团名下：蓝调起源与 Rumours 和声。
